activity_statements.statement: locates underground utilities (electricity, gas, cable, fiber optic, communication lines) before excavation across 48 states and Washington D.C., completing 850,000+ locate requests per month
provides high-risk infrastructure and fiber optic network locating services, operating as the market leader in that specialty
provides mapping, real-time status updates, damage prevention training, and safety services to utility providers and infrastructure operators
deploys locate technicians in the field to physically mark underground utility corridors with paint and flags to enable safe digging

name_reality_gap: The 'Energy Mining & Utilities' index label implies Stake Center is an energy producer or utility operator; it is actually a B2B field services company that locates other utilities' underground infrastructure before construction crews dig. It is closer to an outsourced safety and inspection services firm than an energy company.
